p: Williams will keep making contributions as a pass catcher.
He made several big catches including a spectacular touchdown, which pushes him toward a bigger role as a receiver.
Williams will keep a physical downfield and third-down role in the passing game.
He has made plays on multiple third downs the last two weeks; LaFleur wants more of his size and physicality.
He's a big guy that is physical and we need that from him.
Williams will take on part of the pre-snap motion and slot usage that Jayden Reed had.
Williams could see more snaps and a bigger role, but LaFleur described it as a committee.
